unit.why: This is a Yiddish teaching quoted in the name of R. Shlomo Kluger (רש״ק) about being ashamed before the Sabbath. It explains the consequence in Gan Eden for someone who did not feel the Sabbath's delight, and it has no narrative event.
unit.boundary_note: Ends with the heading 'מענין שוחד', which introduces the next division.
